Data Analyst / Data Engineer

Data.
Impacts.
Insights.

Raw numbers rarely speak for themselves. I build the dashboards, models, and queries that make them impossible to ignore.

I'm a data analyst who helps teams turn scattered information into clear answers and better decisions.

I use Excel, Power BI, and SQL to prepare and explore data, build useful dashboards, and explain what the results mean for a business.

I'm also developing my data engineering skills: organizing data, building repeatable pipelines, and checking that information stays consistent and reliable.

I'm especially interested in using analytics and dependable data workflows to support operations, inventory, and supply chain decisions.
